services.value: Provides Aquatic Toxicity Laboratory services including Whole Effluent Toxicity (WET) testing and Toxicity Identification and Reduction Evaluation (TIE/TRE) studies, as well as wastewater treatability, bioaccumulation studies, and order test specimens. Offers additional analytical and consulting services such as toxicity & chemical analysis, microbial analysis, bench scale & jar testing, permit reviews, and consulting/auditing support.
